initial_hypothesis: Low monthly use mainly reflects episodic dealer jobs
decision_boundary: Episodic tasks and a possible event-specific return appear in two accounts; the main cause of low monthly use is open.

initial_hypothesis: WhatsApp preserves useful conversational context and exception handling
decision_boundary: WhatsApp completed bookings and one respondent would view a digital record for a separate task; exception handling and staffing effects are open.

initial_hypothesis: Digital lead context is not consistently actionable at the branch
decision_boundary: No failed lead handoff, branch submission or lead attribution was captured.

initial_hypothesis: Existing feature fragmentation creates an integration opportunity larger than feature expansion
decision_boundary: Interest concerns approved scope and stronger appraisal evidence; no experiment ranks integration above new functionality.

initial_hypothesis: A lack of situation-specific cost comparisons increases purchase uncertainty
decision_boundary: Running-cost and price comparisons appeared; binding liquidity, quote quality and the effect of providing a comparison are untested.

initial_hypothesis: Toyota/Auto2000 loses some prospects before inquiry because its offer does not fit their desired vehicle class
decision_boundary: Atto over Wuling suggests a vehicle/price preference in one competitive choice; Toyota consideration, inquiry and loss remain unknown.

initial_hypothesis: HEV maintenance contact protects some ownership opportunities despite BEV market growth
decision_boundary: Covered HEV maintenance delivered a service touchpoint; retention after coverage and paid GP remain open.

initial_hypothesis: BEV ownership value shifts toward selected infrequent, high-consequence needs
decision_boundary: Routine Wuling maintenance coexists with consequential charging incidents for Atto. Frequency, technical needs and dealership value are unmeasured.

initial_hypothesis: Service-history completeness and finalization matter more than simple history availability
decision_boundary: The Yaris reaction points to scope, estimate and approval history; relative value and finalization effects are untested.

initial_hypothesis: Quote/invoice differences create avoidable uncertainty at a transition between digital and branch
decision_boundary: Reported work matched expectations in the service cases; there are no quotes or final invoices to test a discrepancy.

initial_hypothesis: Showing task-specific branch capability earlier can reduce wrong routing
decision_boundary: Provider and charging choices are present but no failed workshop routing with verified capability.

initial_hypothesis: Scarce EV technician/bay capacity limits value from additional digital demand
decision_boundary: No EV technician or bay data.

initial_hypothesis: Parts compatibility uncertainty blocks some viable purchases
decision_boundary: No purchase affected by part compatibility was documented.

initial_hypothesis: Body/paint is an under-connected ownership job in digital discovery
decision_boundary: No body/paint episode was documented.

initial_hypothesis: Household roles create a need for shareable, consistent decision evidence
decision_boundary: Split household roles are observed. A shared approval record's take-up and effect are untested.

initial_hypothesis: Fleet administrators value approval and multi-vehicle continuity more than individual app frequency
decision_boundary: No fleet user or multi-vehicle administrator was interviewed.

initial_hypothesis: Requesting some data before proving task value creates avoidable trust friction
decision_boundary: Willingness to give some relevant details in a concept test does not measure early data friction.

initial_hypothesis: Site information inconsistencies arise from distributed publishing governance
decision_boundary: No publishing-governance or source-consistency episode was captured.

initial_hypothesis: Useful content already exists but is disconnected from the relevant next action
decision_boundary: The valuation journey stopped at a plausible range; there is no direct evidence of a specific Digiroom content handoff breaking.

initial_hypothesis: A ranking or traffic issue is less valuable than resolving high-intent decision uncertainty
decision_boundary: Vehicle selection context does not compare attribution, traffic ranking or transaction investment.

initial_hypothesis: An incentive or credit-allocation conflict discourages staff use of Single ID
decision_boundary: No staff incentive, credit-allocation or Single ID decision observed.

initial_hypothesis: Small high-value lifecycle moments may outperform frequent low-value engagement
decision_boundary: One respondent named a plausible event-specific reason to return and one declined; comparative engagement and commercial effect are open.

initial_hypothesis: A digital initiative mostly migrates existing Auto2000 transactions across channels
decision_boundary: Existing WhatsApp completion makes zero incrementality plausible if app booking simply shifts channel; no initiative outcome is measured.

initial_hypothesis: Battery-health evidence is most useful when attached to a purchase/trade-in decision
decision_boundary: The appraisal concept did not establish battery-health evidence acceptance or an offer effect.

initial_hypothesis: A hybrid-heavy installed base allows a different near-term profit strategy from a BEV-heavy new-sales narrative
decision_boundary: Different ownership tasks and eligibility states are visible, with no evidence for installed-base counts or comparative profit.
